info.title: Weather API
info.description:
API for Observations and other weather related data.

---

## Usage

**Main endpoints** (*endpoints with the `Metadata` tag and with `/observations` in the url*)

- These contain all available weather observation data.
- Uses IMO ids (e.g. `1` or `1475`), see `/stations` endpoint.

**EDR endpoints** (*endpoints with `/rodeo` in the url*)

- An OGC EDR API written for the [RODEO project](https://rodeo-project.eu/) which makes HVD data available in Europe through [Meteogate](https://meteogate.eu/).
- Notably these endpoints do not have data from the Icelandic Road and Coastal Administration (Vegagerðin) and a few other select stations.
- Uses WIGOS IDs (e.g. `0-20000-0-04180`).

---

## Code examples


<details>
    <summary>Python</summary>

    import requests

    API_URL = "https://api.vedur.is/weather"

    url = f"{API_URL}/observations/aws/hour"
    params = {
        "station_id": 1350,  # Keflavíkurflugvöllur
        "parameters": "all",
        "format": "json",
        "day_from": "2026-07-30",
        "day_to": "2026-07-31",
    }

    result = requests.get(url, params=params)

    data = result.json()

    print(data[0])

get.description:
Returns weather station information and metadata.

Retrieves details about weather stations including location, type, status,
and operational information. Filter by station IDs, regions, or geographic area.

**Usage:**
- Specify only one filter: `station_id`, `region_id`, or `polygon`
- Use `active` parameter to filter by operational status
- Use `station_type` to filter by AWS or SYNOP stations
- Use `keyword` for text-based station name search

**Notes:**
- Region codes available via [CAP API](https://api.vedur.is/cap/capcreator/forecast_regions/?region_type=met-preset)
- Polygon format: Well-Known Text (WKT) geometry

get.description:
Returns the most recent AWS observations at the specified aggregation level.

Retrieves the latest available observation for each station, filtered by the
specified time aggregation (10min, hourly, daily, monthly, yearly).

**Usage:**
- Specify either `station_id` or `region_id` (mutually exclusive)
- If neither specified, returns data for all stations

**Data Recency:**
- **10min/hourly**: Within last 24 hours
- **Daily**: Within last 7 days
- **Monthly**: Within last month
- **Yearly**: Within last year

**Notes:**
- Returns only one observation per station (the most recent)
- Region codes available via [CAP API](https://api.vedur.is/cap/capcreator/forecast_regions/?region_type=met-preset)

tags.name: SYNOP
tags.description:
[Surface synoptic observations (SYNOP)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SYNOP) from staffed weather stations.

Data gathered from SYNOP stations occur at different interval and may change during the lifetime of the station.
For example, some observations are every 3 hours following the interval `[3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24]` , others every 9 hours following the interval `[9, 18]`.
